notes.title: August Update (Version 1.0.5) and a small summary of all patches so far
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441357/b4fbad8a5ebed1a03cdca1c0c7c134008c83ed70.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

There is another update for Lyantei today, adding a non-binary option to the choices of your gender.
Also, I want to take a second to thank everyone who bought and will buy Lyantei. Your support is very appreciated and if you have any feedback, criticism or other remarks, please post them in the comment section below. Thank you!

[h1]Patch notes (1.0.5 only)[/h1]

[list]
[*] You are now able to choose non-binary as your gender. You will be able start a romantic relationship with whoever you choose.
[/list]


[h1]Prior patch notes (1.0.1. to 1.0.4)[/h1]

[list]
[*] Minor gameplay tweaks and grammar correction (1.0.1)
[*] Change the gameplay slightly, so the player would feel less dependent on the other characters to save the tavern (1.0.2)
[*] Added a story event that informs the player about which stories they have triggered and which they might have missed earlier (1.0.3)
[*] You are now able to ignore tavern management and experience the story, if you want to. To do so, just answer „I just want to experience the story.“ when asked. (1.0.4)
[/list]

Have a nice day and have fun with Lyantei! :D

notes.title: June Update (Version 1.0.4)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441357/b4fbad8a5ebed1a03cdca1c0c7c134008c83ed70.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

There is an update for Lyantei today, introducing a "pure story" mode and a small bug fix. This game mode is targeted at players that found the management system too repetitive and/or the hints to starting the different story lines to cryptic.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] You are now able to ignore tavern management and experience the story, if you want to. To do so, just answer „I just want to experience the story.“ when asked.
[*] The player will no longer be able to have a romance with other characters, after having one with Redin.
[/list]


Have a nice day and have fun with Lyantei! :D

notes.title: April Update Nr 1 (Version 1.0.3)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441357/b4fbad8a5ebed1a03cdca1c0c7c134008c83ed70.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

There is a small update today that adds an event and some other, smaller things to the game.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[*] Added an event that triggers at the start of the 4th day. Ethna will approach the player and they will have a brief conversation. During this conversation the player will confirm what events they have (or haven't) triggered. Ethna will give the player hints on what they might have to do during their next playthrough to trigger all the other storylines.
[*] Added the help.pdf file to the file directory so you can read it while offline. You can find the file under (installfolder)\Lyantei-win\game . It is called help.pdf .
[*] Fixed a display error in the German version. The game will no longer tell the player that their cooking utensils are in bad shape when they just didn't have enough meat to cook.

notes.title: March Update Nr 2 (Version 1.0.2)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/1022000/9dbcc1e1341b402cbf7c63a2397e604c8cea8f2d.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

There is a small update to ensure that a good ending can be achieved without receiving any extra help from (some of) the tenants.


[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Greatly increased the amount of food you receive from hunting and cooking (so you don't need Ydrienne later on)
[*] Increased the amount of medicine produced (so you don't need Ara's financial aid)
[*] Increased the amount of reputation and wood you gained (so you don't need Saj's additional work shift)
[/list]


Also, I am considering to add a new event at the beginning of the 4. day so the player can find out what events they triggered at what time and what they needed to do for the others.


Have a nice day! :D

notes.title: March Update (Version 1.0.1.)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34441357/b4fbad8a5ebed1a03cdca1c0c7c134008c83ed70.png[/img]

Hello everyone! I'm bringing a small update live today to make the goods that you produce at the tavern more valuable!


[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

*Corrected a number of spelling mistakes in both the English and the German version of the game.
*Cooked meat is now worth [i]3 gold[/i] instead of 2
*Healing potions are now worth [i]6 gold[/i] instead of 4
*Antidotes are now worth [i]9 gold[/i] instead of 5
*Elixirs are now worth [i]12 gold[/i] instead of 6
*Herbal liquor is now worth [i]15 gold[/i] instead of 10


If anyone has any ideas on how to improve Lyantei, please comment! I am open for all suggestions! 

Have a great weekend! ;D
